answer: Three bugs fixed. (1) QB25 does not exist on garnet, which has QB1 to QB20 only. I used QB2, which is coupled to QB1. (2) "cx" is not an IQM native gate. The native two-qubit gate is "cz", and the only valid garnet pair here is locus [QB2, QB1]. (3) The circuit had no Hadamard-style step on the target, so cz alone would not make a Bell pair. New circuit: prx(pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB2 and on QB1, cz [QB2, QB1], then prx(-pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB1, then measure both qubits with key m. The fixed circuit is in bell_fixed.json in the worktree. The mock returned 00: 50 and 11: 50 (100 shots, no 01 or 10). This was a mock job, so 0 credits were used.
